Priya - Customer Success: Quick post-all-hands ask: drop one line each on why we won or lost the deals mentioned earlier so we can prioritize follow-ups.
Nia - Product: Win: DataStream chose us for predictable costs + fast streaming responses; they cited our console traces for debugging.
Owen - Sales: Loss: Atlas Financial wanted an on-prem option + documented HSM integration, timeline mismatch.
Lina - Eng: Atlas technical: long sequences + strict audit retention caused perf + ops gaps. We can propose a scoped on-prem deployment but need security signoff.
Diane - Marketing: DataStream case could be a quick social post once we get permission.
Tom - CEO: Pattern: startups buy developer velocity, enterprises buy compliance and deployment models. Let's get three deliverables: 1) a sales battlecard on compliance gaps; 2) Dedicated onboarding checklist; 3) an engineering playbook for long-sequence workloads. Nia, can Product own 1 and 2?
Nia - Product: Yes — I'll own the battlecard and checklist. Need Eng + Sales reviewers. Owen, can you nominate reviewers?
Owen - Sales: I'll loop in Priya and Nate from AE. Also request a one-pager risk memo for RFP attachments.
Lina - Eng: I'll write the long-sequence playbook. Plan: short runbook + prefix-cache snippet + rollout canary steps. ETA 10 days.
Priya - Customer Success: I'll surface the list of impacted deals and specific asks by EOD and tag owners.
Diane - Marketing: I'll prep a "why teams pick Redwood" one-pager aimed at developer-first startups (bullets: unified runtime, cost predictability, safe rollouts).
Tom - CEO: Good. Prioritize the battlecard — losing enterprise deals costs more. Nia + Owen + Priya sync and share a draft by Tuesday.
task-bot: Created task RW-1502 "All-hands: enterprise battlecard + onboarding checklist" assigned to Nia.
Priya - Customer Success: Posted affected deals: DataStream (won), Atlas Financial (lost), NovaRetail (won), SecureBank (lost). Link: <https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/allhands/deals-1834567890>
Tom - CEO: Thanks everyone. Keep updates concise in this thread so we can track progress. :rocket:
